about.heroTagline: Documentary Production, From Research to Broadcast
about.heroDescription: Luxor Film is a documentary production company. We support production companies and networks at any stage of a documentary, or take on the whole production ourselves.
storyParagraphs: We specialize in documentary filmmaking: research and script development, interview production, drama and docudrama scenes, and full episode delivery.

Some partners bring us in for a single phase, such as research for an existing project or interviews in another country. Others hand us the whole production, from the first idea to a broadcast-ready episode. Either way, we work with the same care and attention to detail.
